name: ris-austria-mcp-server
description: Search Austrian consolidated federal & state law, court decisions, and the authentic Bundesgesetzblatt from the official RIS via MCP. Keyless. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

ris_contact.title: RIS Contact
ris_contact.description: Optional contact string appended to the User-Agent. RIS netiquette asks integrators to be identifiable; no API key is needed.

ris_api_base_url.title: RIS API Base URL
ris_api_base_url.description: RIS OGD REST API base URL. Leave blank for the official endpoint.

ris_content_base_url.title: RIS Content Base URL
ris_content_base_url.description: RIS document content host that rendition URLs are built on and documents are fetched from. document_url also accepts www. and ogd.ris.bka.gv.at. Leave blank for the default, https://ogd.ris.bka.gv.at — www.ris.bka.gv.at answers automated clients with a bot-check page.

ris_fold_input_spellings.title: Fold Input Spellings
ris_fold_input_spellings.description: Accept a court or application code in any letter case, and a state by its German or English name, folding it to the code before validation. Turn off for strict validation.
